t: A thumb-sized LoRa radio kit that runs Meshtastic out of the box.
steps: Buy the kit from the Seeed Studio store for about 11 to 14 US dollars. Choose the ESP32S3 version for Wi-Fi or the nRF52840 version for long battery life.
Stack the XIAO board onto the radio board if they arrive apart.
Attach the LoRa antenna before you power it on.
Plug the kit into a USB-C cable.
Install the free Meshtastic app on your phone and pair over Bluetooth.
Set the LoRa region to your country. This keeps the radio on the legal license-free band.
Send a test message to a second Meshtastic radio.
Kits bought before late October 2024 need flashing first. Follow the Seeed wiki guide for your version.
meta: Open Board. From $10.90. A few stores.
